title: 这些新娘们为何选择彩色的婚纱?
desc: 这些新娘们为何选择彩色的婚纱?

paragraphs.en: The traditional white dress may no longer be the dream of the many with some brides choosing to wear something different on their big day.
paragraphs.zh: 传统的白色婚纱可能不再是许多人的梦想，一些新娘选择在自己的大喜之日穿些与众不同的衣服。

paragraphs.en: In April, searches on Pinterest were up 240% for "unique wedding dresses", with those looking for blush pink wedding dresses up 60% and black dresses up 50%.
paragraphs.zh: 四月份，Pinterest上对“独特婚纱”的搜索量增长了240%，其中寻找腮红粉色婚纱的搜索量增长了60%，黑色婚纱的搜索量增长了50%。

paragraphs.en: With some brides opting to forego the classic look, six women tell us about their colorful dresses and what inspired them to go against the grain.
paragraphs.zh: 随着一些新娘选择放弃经典造型，六位女性向我们讲述了她们色彩斑斓的婚纱以及是什么激励她们打破常规。

paragraphs.en: For Kitty, 32, though she liked a traditional white wedding dress it just wasn't for her.
paragraphs.zh: 对于32岁的凯蒂来说，尽管她喜欢传统的白色婚纱，但这并不适合她。

paragraphs.en: "I chose red as I've always been a fan of alternative style and while a gorgeous white gown is a beloved classic for a reason, it just didn't feel right on me," she said.
paragraphs.zh: 她说：“我选择了红色，因为我一直偏爱非传统风格，虽然华丽的白色礼服成为经典是有原因的，但穿在我身上就是感觉不对劲。”

paragraphs.en: Inspired by the use of red in Asian weddings, Kitty, who lives in Leeds, UK, and works in software implementation, wanted a dress color that was "loud".
paragraphs.zh: 受到亚洲婚礼中使用红色的启发，居住在英国利兹、从事软件实施工作的凯蒂想要一件颜色“张扬”的礼服。

paragraphs.en: She chose the "simple" dress from ASOS Design and bought a crown from Carbickova Crowns and a veil from Holly Winter Couture.
paragraphs.zh: 她选择了ASOS Design的“简约”款礼服，并从Carbickova Crowns购买了一顶头冠，从Holly Winter Couture购买了一款头纱。

paragraphs.en: "I've been lucky enough through travel and growing up in Birmingham to see lots of other cultures' wedding traditions first-hand, and red features often in both east and south Asian bridal wear.
paragraphs.zh: "我很幸运，通过旅行以及在伯明翰的成长经历，能够亲眼目睹许多其他文化的婚礼传统，而红色在东亚和南亚的新娘服饰中常常出现。

paragraphs.en: I've always found it so striking and beautiful so I wanted to respectfully incorporate that into my wedding."
paragraphs.zh: 我一直觉得它如此引人注目且美丽，所以我希望以尊重的态度将其融入我的婚礼。"

paragraphs.en: Anne from Sheffield in the UK has always liked colorful clothes and knew that her wedding dress was going to be the "brightest thing" she could imagine.
paragraphs.zh: 来自英国谢菲尔德的安妮一直喜欢色彩鲜艳的衣服，并且认为她的婚纱将是她能想象到的“最亮眼的东西”。

paragraphs.en: While looking for inspiration she came across the La Chimère collection by Thierry Mugler and fell in love.
paragraphs.zh: 在寻找灵感时，她偶然发现了蒂埃里·穆勒的"幻梦"系列，并一见倾心。

paragraphs.en: "I scoured charity shops for sparkly clothing I could cut up, and sewed thousands of scales together to make a corset, skirt and jacket," said the 47-year-old civil servant.
paragraphs.zh: “我翻遍了慈善商店，寻找可以剪裁的闪亮衣物，并将数千片鳞片缝制在一起，做成了一件紧身胸衣、一条裙子和一件夹克，”这位47岁的公务员说道。

paragraphs.en: "It took eight months to make and has scales made by family, my son and includes snippets of my late mother's clothing, so it ended up being a bit of an artwork as well as an outfit. I adored wearing it."
paragraphs.zh: 制作这件衣服花了八个月时间，鳞片是家人做的，我儿子也参与其中，还融入了我已故母亲衣服的碎片，所以它最后不仅是一套服装，还成了一件艺术品。我很喜欢穿它。

paragraphs.en: "I've never quite felt like I look my best in white," said Kate, 38, from Richmond, Virginia, who is pleased she let go of the notion of getting a white wedding dress early on in her search.
paragraphs.zh: "我从未觉得自己穿白色最好看，"来自弗吉尼亚州里士满、38岁的凯特说道，她很庆幸自己在寻找婚纱的早期阶段就放弃了选择白色婚纱的想法。

paragraphs.en: Before she was engaged, she started looking at examples of silver wedding dresses and stumbled across La Novale on Etsy, a Ukrainian boutique based in Odesa.
paragraphs.zh: 在她订婚之前，她就开始浏览银色婚纱的范例，并偶然在Etsy上发现了LaNovale，这是一家位于敖德萨的乌克兰精品店。

paragraphs.en: "I knew it was the right choice for me," said Kate, who works as a data analyst.
paragraphs.zh: "我知道这对我来说是正确的选择，"从事数据分析师工作的凯特说。

paragraphs.en: "I tried on several traditional white options with my mom, but we both thought this one felt more authentic to my style and personality.
paragraphs.zh: "我和妈妈试穿了几件传统的白色婚纱，但我们俩都觉得这件更符合我的风格和个性。"

paragraphs.en: "Silver felt fun and festive but also bold and modern while still seeming bridal. My husband, Austin, and I were married at an art museum and I think it also really complimented the venue."
paragraphs.zh: "银色感觉有趣而喜庆，同时也大胆而现代，却仍不失婚纱的感觉。我的丈夫奥斯汀和我在一家艺术博物馆结婚，我认为它也与场地相得益彰。"

paragraphs.en: It was 53-year-old Hanneke's second marriage when she married Nigel so she didn't want to wear white. Instead, she chose orange as "a clear reference to my Dutch heritage" and decided to make her wedding dress herself.
paragraphs.zh: 53岁的汉内克和奈杰尔结婚时，是她的第二次婚姻，所以她不想穿白色婚纱。相反，她选择了橙色，“这明显是为了体现我的荷兰血统”，并且决定自己制作婚纱。

paragraphs.en: "I bought the silk for around 15 pounds ($20) per meter from a place in Goldhawk Road, west London, and it took me around three weeks to make," said Hanneke, who lives in Grays, Essex in the UK and works as an assistant for an interior design company.
paragraphs.zh: “我从伦敦西部戈德霍克路的一个地方以每米约15英镑（20美元）的价格买了这种丝绸，制作花了我大约三周时间。”住在英国埃塞克斯郡格雷市、在一家室内设计公司担任助理的汉内克说。

paragraphs.en: "At the time I only told a few people about the color. As we planned for all the men to wear morning suits with different colored cravats, I had to be careful in steering my husband towards wearing a non-clashing color.
paragraphs.zh: 当时我只跟几个人说了这种颜色。因为我们计划让所有男士都穿晨礼服，搭配不同颜色的领结，所以我得小心引导我丈夫选择不会冲突的颜色。

paragraphs.en: "My Dutch family and friends loved the dress and my British friends thought it was a daring but fitting choice. I looked and felt like a million bucks."
paragraphs.zh: 我的荷兰家人和朋友都很喜欢这条裙子，我的英国朋友们则认为这是一个大胆却恰到好处的选择。我看起来和感觉都美极了。

paragraphs.en: For Jasmine and her husband, Michael, in Vancouver, Canada, their original plan was to get married in Tuscany, Italy, in May 2020 but the Covid pandemic meant that wasn't possible.
paragraphs.zh: 对于加拿大温哥华的贾斯敏和她的丈夫迈克尔来说，他们原本计划于2020年5月在意大利托斯卡纳结婚，但新冠疫情使得这一计划无法实现。

paragraphs.en: "The original intention was to wear this dress to the welcome dinner," said the 34-year-old who works in real estate finance.
paragraphs.zh: “原本打算穿这条裙子去参加欢迎晚宴，”这位34岁、从事房地产金融工作的女士说道。

paragraphs.en: "We instead pivoted and had a small, beautiful back yard ceremony in my parents' home where I grew up."
paragraphs.zh: “但我们后来改变了主意，在我成长的父母家举行了一场小型而美丽的后院婚礼。”

paragraphs.en: Jasmine was drawn to the floral design of the dress, designed by Marchesa Notte, and thought the light peach color would work well with her skin tone.
paragraphs.zh: 贾斯敏被婚纱上的花卉设计所吸引，这款婚纱由诺特夫人设计，她觉得浅桃色的色调与自己的肤色非常相配。

paragraphs.en: "Our wedding took place in spring and the dress epitomized everything I love about the beautiful blooms of that time of year."
paragraphs.zh: “我们的婚礼在春天举行，这件婚纱完美体现了我钟爱的那一年四季中所有的美丽花朵。”

paragraphs.en: With only four weeks to find a wedding dress, Q, 55, was "nervous" about how she would get one in time.
paragraphs.zh: 55岁的Q只有四周时间挑选婚纱，她很紧张自己能否及时找到合适的婚纱。

paragraphs.en: "I had defaulted to a plain white pantsuit, but when I put it on I felt uninspired," said the compliance and risk professional from Oregon.
paragraphs.zh: 这位来自俄勒冈州的合规与风险管理专业人士表示：“我原本一直想穿一套纯白西裤套装，但穿上后感觉毫无灵感。”

paragraphs.en: Feeling it was too late to order a wedding dress, she spotted a small sign offering alterations on a bulletin board at Stumptown Coffee, a local coffee shop.
paragraphs.zh: 她觉得订婚纱已经太晚了。她在本地咖啡馆Stumptown Coffee的公告栏上看到一块小广告，上面写着可以修改婚纱。

paragraphs.en: "I took the chance and met Diane – I can't recall her last name – and she was lovely."
paragraphs.zh: “于是我抓住机会见到了戴安娜——我记不清她的姓氏了——她非常友善。”

paragraphs.en: They went fabric shopping and found an "amazing dark green that shimmered chartreuse and had silver embroidery".
paragraphs.zh: 他们去逛了布料店，发现了一款“令人惊叹的深绿色款式——带有光泽的青草绿，还配有银色刺绣”。

paragraphs.en: Despite not starting out thinking she specifically wanted a green dress, Q knew it was the color for her.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管一开始她并不确定自己是否特别想要一条绿色连衣裙，但Q知道这正是适合她的颜色。

paragraphs.en: "There had been a photo in a Martha Stewart magazine in which several women had similar long skirts and wraps, but in different colors.
paragraphs.zh: “《玛莎·斯图尔特》杂志上曾刊登过一张照片，照片中几位女性穿着相似的长裙和裹身裙，但颜色不同。

paragraphs.en: I had thought that it was an elegant solution in which the same outfit could be worn again and mix-and-match a top depending on weather.
paragraphs.zh: 我原以为这是一种优雅的搭配方式，同一套服装可以重复穿着，并根据天气变化搭配不同的上衣。

paragraphs.en: My wedding was 24 years ago and I've worn it over a dozen times at various formal events."
paragraphs.zh: 我是24年前举行的婚礼，而我在各种正式场合中穿了十多次这套服装。”
